intro_en: Learn how to talk about having your wallet or phone stolen on a crowded bus or at a market, and how to report it to the police. You'll also learn the difference between -ж хаях (gone and lost for good) and -ж орхих (left behind, forgot somewhere).
intro_mn: Хүн ихтэй автобус эсвэл захад түрийвч, утсаа хулгайд алдсан тухай ярьж, цагдаад мэдүүлэх аргад суралцана. Англи хэлний get stolen, get lost, get taken болон be stolen хэлбэрүүдийн ялгааг мөн үзнэ.

vocab.example_en: I had my phone stolen on the bus.
My wallet was in my back pocket.
My ID card was in my wallet.
You need to give a statement to the police.
There are a lot of pickpockets at the market.
The police came and talked with us.

vocab.example_mn: Иргэний үнэмлэхээ шинээр захиалах хэрэгтэй болсон.
vocab.example_en: I had to order a new ID card.
The morning bus was packed with people.
Report the theft to the police right away.

sentences.mn: Өглөө автобус хүнээр дүүрэн байхад хэн нэгэн миний халааснаас утсыг минь сугалж авчээ.
sentences.en: This morning, while the bus was packed, someone pulled my phone out of my pocket.
alt_en: Someone took my phone out of my pocket this morning while the bus was crowded.
sentences.mn_latin: Öglöö avtobus khüneer düüren baikhad khen negen minii khalaasnaas utsyg mini sugalj avchee.

sentences.mn: Би түрийвчээ хулгайд алдсанаа гэртээ ирээд л мэдсэн.
sentences.en: I only realized my wallet had been stolen when I got home.
alt_en: I didn't realize my wallet got stolen until I got home.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi türiivchee khulgaid aldsanaa gertee ireed l medsen.

sentences.mn: Захад цүнхээ онгорхой орхисон болохоор түрийвчээ хулгайд алдчихсан.
sentences.en: I left my bag open at the market, so my wallet got stolen.
alt_en: My wallet got stolen at the market because I left my bag open.
sentences.mn_latin: Zakhad tsünkhee ongorkhoi orkhison bolokhoor türiivchee khulgaid aldchikhsan.

sentences.mn: Утсаа хулгайд алдсан уу, эсвэл зүгээр гээж хаясан уу, сайн мэдэхгүй байна.
sentences.en: I'm not sure whether my phone got stolen or I just lost it.
alt_en: I don't know if my phone was stolen or if I just lost it.
sentences.mn_latin: Utsaa khulgaid aldsan uu, esvel zügeer geej khayasan uu, sain medekhgüi baina.

sentences.mn: Цүнхээ автобусны суудал дээр мартаж орхисон байна.
sentences.en: I left my bag behind on the bus seat.
alt_mn: Цүнхээ автобусны суудал дээр мартчихсан байна.
alt_en: I forgot my bag on the bus seat.
sentences.mn_latin: Tsünkhee avtobusny suudal deer martaj orkhison baina.

sentences.mn: Цагдаагийн хэлтэст очиж мэдүүлэг өгөхөд бараг нэг цаг болсон.
sentences.en: Giving a statement at the police station took almost an hour.
alt_en: It took almost an hour to give a statement at the police station.
sentences.mn_latin: Tsagdaagiin kheltest ochij medüüleg ögökhöd barag neg tsag bolson.

sentences.mn: Түрийвчинд минь иргэний үнэмлэх, банкны хоёр карт байсан.
sentences.en: My ID card and two bank cards were in my wallet.
alt_en: I had my ID card and two bank cards in my wallet.
sentences.mn_latin: Türiivchind mini irgenii ünemlekh, bankny khoyor kart baisan.

sentences.mn: Картаа хаалгахын тулд банк руу шууд залгасан.
sentences.en: I called the bank right away to block my cards.
alt_en: I immediately called the bank to have my cards blocked.
sentences.mn_latin: Kartaa khaalgakhyn tuld bank ruu shuud zalgasan.

sentences.mn: Манай ах өнгөрсөн сард яг ийм байдлаар утсаа хулгайд алдсан.
sentences.en: My older brother got his phone stolen the same way last month.
alt_en: Last month my older brother had his phone stolen exactly like this.
sentences.mn_latin: Manai akh öngörsön sard yag iim baidlaar utsaa khulgaid aldsan.

sentences.mn: Хүн ихтэй газар утсаа арын халаасандаа бүү хийгээрэй.
sentences.en: Don't put your phone in your back pocket in crowded places.
alt_en: In crowded places, don't keep your phone in your back pocket.
sentences.mn_latin: Khün ikhtei gazar utsaa aryn khalaasandaa büü khiigeerei.

sentences.mn: Тэр шинэ бээлийгээ хаа нэгтээ гээж хаячихаад их харамсаж байна.
sentences.en: She went and lost her new gloves somewhere, and she really regrets it.
alt_en: She lost her new gloves somewhere and feels really bad about it.
sentences.mn_latin: Ter shine beeliigee khaa negtee geej khayachikhaad ikh kharamsaj baina.

sentences.mn: Түрийвчийг олбол над руу залгаарай гээд жолоочид утасны дугаараа үлдээсэн.
sentences.en: I left my phone number with the driver and asked him to call me if he found the wallet.
alt_en: I gave the driver my number so he could call me if he found the wallet.
sentences.mn_latin: Türiivchiig olbol nad ruu zalgaarai geed joloochid utasny dugaaraa üldeesen.

grammar.title_en: -ж хаях vs -ж орхих: lost for good vs left behind
grammar.title_mn: Get stolen / get lost ба be stolen
grammar.explain_en: Mongolian often adds a helper verb after the -ж/-ч form to color an action. -ж хаях (literally 'and throw away') means something is completely and carelessly gone: гээж хаясан = 'I went and lost it (and it's gone).' -ж орхих (literally 'and leave') means you left something behind, often by forgetting: мартаж орхисон = 'I forgot it (somewhere) and left it there.' Use хаях when the thing is lost for good and you sound annoyed with yourself. Use орхих when you know roughly where you left it. In speech, -чих- (гээчихсэн, мартчихсан) is also very common.
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд хулгайд алдсан зүйлийн тухай ярихдаа 'be stolen' болон 'get stolen' гэсэн хоёр хэлбэр хэрэглэдэг. 'My wallet was stolen' нь албан, мэдүүлэг, мэдээнд тохиромжтой. 'My wallet got stolen' нь ярианы, гэнэтийн, санаандгүй болсон явдлыг онцолдог. Мөн 'get lost' нь 'төөрөх' (We got lost), 'get taken' нь 'авагдах, хулгайлагдах' гэсэн утгатай. Анхаар: 'I stole my wallet' гэж хэлж болохгүй! 'I had my wallet stolen' гэвэл 'Би түрийвчээ хулгайд алдсан' гэсэн утгатай.

examples.en: I went and lost my keys.
I left my umbrella at the café.
My wallet got stolen on the bus.
We got lost at the market.

fill_blank.translation: I had my wallet stolen on the bus.
fill_blank.explain_en: 'To have something stolen' is the fixed phrase хулгайд алдах. Гээх alone means to lose, and it can't follow хулгайд.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'Хулгайд алдах' нь тогтмол хэллэг. Англиар 'I had my wallet stolen' эсвэл 'My wallet got stolen' гэнэ.

fill_blank.translation: I left my umbrella behind at the café.
fill_blank.explain_en: With мартах ('forget'), use -ж орхих: you left it somewhere and know roughly where it is.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Мартаж орхисон зүйлийг англиар 'leave something behind' эсвэл 'forget something somewhere' гэнэ.

fill_blank.translation: You need to give a statement to the police.
fill_blank.explain_en: Мэдүүлэг өгөх = to give a statement. It's the standard phrase at a police station.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Англиар 'give a statement' эсвэл 'file a report' гэж хэлнэ.

fill_blank.text: My wallet got ___ on the bus.
fill_blank.explain_en: After 'get' in the passive sense, use the past participle: stolen.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'Get' + гуравдугаар хэлбэр (past participle) нь үйлдэл тухайн зүйлд тохиолдсоныг илэрхийлнэ: steal – stole – stolen.

fill_blank.text: We got ___ in the market and couldn't find the exit.
fill_blank.translation: Бид захад төөрөөд гарцаа олж чадсангүй.
fill_blank.explain_en: 'Get lost' means to lose your way.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'Get lost' нь 'төөрөх' гэсэн утгатай. Харин 'lose something' нь 'юм гээх' гэсэн утгатай.

fill_blank.text: Be careful, or your phone will get ___.
fill_blank.translation: Болгоомжтой байгаарай, эс бөгөөс утсаа хулгайд алдчихна.
fill_blank.explain_en: 'Get taken' is a casual way to say 'get stolen.' Use the past participle: taken.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'Get taken' нь 'get stolen'-ий ярианы хувилбар. Take – took – taken.

dialogue.speaker: Сараа
dialogue.mn: Сайн байна уу. Би автобусанд түрийвчээ хулгайд алдчихлаа.
dialogue.en: Hello. My wallet got stolen on the bus.
dialogue.mn_latin: Sain baina uu. Bi avtobusand türiivchee khulgaid aldchikhlaa.

dialogue.speaker: Бат
dialogue.mn: Сайн байна уу. Хэзээ, аль автобусанд болсон бэ?
dialogue.en: Hello. When did it happen, and on which bus?
dialogue.mn_latin: Sain baina uu. Khezee, ali avtobusand bolson be?

dialogue.speaker: Сараа
dialogue.mn: Өнөө өглөө, Нарантуул зах руу явдаг автобусанд. Хүнээр дүүрэн байсан.
dialogue.en: This morning, on the bus to Naran Tuul market. It was packed.
dialogue.mn_latin: Önöö öglöö, Narantuul zakh ruu yavdag avtobusand. Khüneer düüren baisan.

dialogue.speaker: Бат
dialogue.mn: Түрийвч тань хаана байсан бэ? Цүнхэнд үү, халаасанд уу?
dialogue.en: Where was your wallet? In your bag or in your pocket?
dialogue.mn_latin: Türiivch tani khaana baisan be? Tsünkhend üü, khalaasand uu?

dialogue.speaker: Сараа
dialogue.mn: Хүрэмнийхээ халаасанд. Эхлээд би зүгээр гээж хаясан гэж бодсон.
dialogue.en: In my jacket pocket. At first I thought I'd just lost it.
dialogue.mn_latin: Khüremniikhee khalaasand. Ekhleed bi zügeer geej khayasan gej bodson.

dialogue.speaker: Бат
dialogue.mn: Дотор нь юу байсан бэ? Картаа хаалгасан уу?
dialogue.en: What was inside? Did you block your cards?
dialogue.mn_latin: Dotor ni yuu baisan be? Kartaa khaalgasan uu?

dialogue.speaker: Сараа
dialogue.mn: Иргэний үнэмлэх, хоёр карт байсан. Картаа аль хэдийн хаалгачихсан.
dialogue.en: My ID card and two cards. I've already blocked the cards.
dialogue.mn_latin: Irgenii ünemlekh, khoyor kart baisan. Kartaa ali khediin khaalgachikhsan.

dialogue.speaker: Бат
dialogue.mn: Сайн байна. Одоо энэ хуудсыг бөглөөд мэдүүлгийг тань авъя.
dialogue.en: Good. Now let's fill out this form and take your statement.
dialogue.mn_latin: Sain baina. Odoo ene khuudsyg böglööd medüülgiig tani avya.

culture_note.en: Ulaanbaatar's buses get extremely crowded at rush hour, and Naran Tuul market (often called the 'Black Market') is well known for pickpockets. Locals often carry their bags in front of them and keep phones in inner pockets. If something is stolen, you can call the police at 102 and give a statement at the nearest police station.
culture_note.mn: Улаанбаатарын автобусанд оргил цагаар маш их хүн шахцалддаг бөгөөд Нарантуул зах халаасны хулгайгаараа алдартай. Иймээс хотынхон цүнхээ урдаа барьж, утсаа дотор халаасандаа хийх нь элбэг. Ямар нэг юм хулгайд алдвал 102 руу залгаж, ойролцоох цагдаагийн хэлтэст мэдүүлэг өгч болно.

review.notes: Strong, natural lesson overall. The main issues were a wrong verb in the dialogue (өгөх vs авах), one inaccurate gloss, and one illogical subject in the culture note.

opus_fix.notes: The en/mn split in the intro and grammar is kept on purpose: English speakers learn the Mongolian -ж хаях/-ж орхих contrast, Mongolian speakers learn English get/be stolen. Only the tense error, one possessive and one colloquial loanword needed fixing.

changes.why: Reported speech needs the past tense: 'found', not 'finds'.
'Утсыг минь' is the natural possessive here, matching 'my phone'.
'Куртик' is a colloquial Russian loan. The standard word is 'хүрэм'.
